record.dic_text:
896 Baal {bah'-al}

源自希伯來文 SNH01168; 陽性專有名詞

欽定本 - Baal 1; 1

巴力 = "主"
1) 迦南人與腓尼基人的至尊男神 (#羅11:4|), 亞舍拉為至尊女神
record.edic_text:
896 Baal {bah'-al}

of Hebrew origin 01168;; n pr m

AV - Baal 1; 1

Baal = "lord"
1) the supreme male divinity of the Phoenician and Canaanitish
   nations, as Ashtoreth was their supreme female divinity
